_doc: Probe questions for the RAGAS-style scorecard. These are NOT a gold set — there are no 'expected files'. RAGAS metrics are reference-free: a judge scores each answer for faithfulness/relevancy against the contexts the agent actually retrieved. The last entry is a negative control (the feature doesn't exist) to score honest abstention. The namespace must be ingested first.
